list: All 55 trophies — names, descriptions and grades cross-checked against the kit dataset and public lists (Insider Gaming, GTABase, PowerPyx), 20 Nov 2026
rarity_source: Exophase player percentages, 20 Nov 2026 (day 2 after launch — expect them to climb fast)
platinum_estimate: Difficulty 4/10, roughly 200 hours, single playthrough enough (PowerPyx)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own — there is no separate task. Work through the roadmap phases below (story, then 100%, then strangers and clean-up) and it lands with the last trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It pops at the end of the first mission — no detours, no special conditions.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only — keep playing the gold-marked missions until the chapter card rolls. Watch for the missable meditation spot on Lucia's balcony in this chapter (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Unmissable if you play through the story; the chapter-complete card is the trigger, so just follow the mission markers.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 — story progression only. No side content is required for the chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last story chapter before the finale. After this, the final mission trophy is next.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. One playthrough is enough — PowerPyx confirms no branching ending blocks it, so play the ending you like.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during Chapter 1 — follow the B marker on the map and finish the run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a mid-game story heist. Bring a fast getaway car and keep your partner alive through the escape.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story marker only — no preparation needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story mission in the Vice City club scene — follow the objective prompts and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport story mission. Stealth helps but a loud approach still clears it — pick whichever you are comfortable with.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A heavy combat story mission — stock up on armor and ammo before you start.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (35 tasks) appears after the credits with an in-game tracker. It is lenient: 70 of 80 challenges, 100 of 255 animals and 200 of 277 vehicles count — you do not need literally everything (Insider Gaming). This is the hardest trophy in the set, so leave it for last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Any stunt counts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, air time. Farm the airport runway jumps or the big Vice City ramps; the counter is cumulative across the whole game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, drone racing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, golf, darts, pool and street races. One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The hardest pure-skill trophy: use Combat Focus, learn each range's target pattern, and retry single challenges — progress saves per challenge, so chip away at it.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each track's shortcut gates; the drone handles like a boat in wind — tap the throttle on turns instead of holding it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Mix street, off-road and boat races — each unique race name counts once; repeat wins on the same race do not stack.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal shows up at the fishing spots after the early story; match his catch weight by reeling in short bursts when the line goes slack.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any cabinet in any arcade counts — pick the shortest game; the claw-style one clears in minutes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand starts at the rehab center marker — finish every mission in his chain in order.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's boat-yard strand — work through his missions in order until the finale unlocks.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's biker strand — the last mission unlocks after the earlier ones in his chain.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in total, so pick the shortest — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more. The '?' markers on the map are your checklist.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's supply-run strand — the final mission is a timed delivery, so take the highway route and avoid shortcuts through traffic.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's DJ strand — the finale is a club set; keep the crowd meter up and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer agree: the Chapter 1 spot on Lucia's balcony after 'Down to Earth' may lock once you leave. Meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and do the balcony one in Chapter 1 before moving on.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks the animal's territory — track it with the hunting scope and take a clean shot; scaring it off just makes it respawn nearby.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide in shops, houses and mission areas — trade duplicates with the in-game card exchange to finish sets faster.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app marks tagged spots — open it in each new area and tap every prompt; cities cluster 20+ tags each.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and activities — the pause menu lists them; knock out the easy driving ones first. You need 70 of 80 for 100%, so 50 comes naturally on the road to the platinum.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you. Get 4 stars (rob a store, then shoot it out), then drive with your partner to a quiet alley and wait out the search — do not split up.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of 3 close shops and keep the same wanted level throughout — do not let it drop to zero between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Just drive or sit in 100 distinct vehicle models — the vehicle log tracks them. Variety beats speed: try every parking lot and car meet you pass.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus. Trigger Focus in a gang shootout with a shotgun — 5 kills inside one slow-mo window counts.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Grab a plane at the airport and take off without clearance — the runway lights are your cue.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — survive a Rhino tank encounter. Lure a Rhino into a narrow street, then hit its rear armor; the trophy pops when the encounter ends.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go at night, cut the cameras first, and stick to the back room — one spotted guard fails it, so save before you enter.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a mini-heist: crack the safe, grab the cash, lose the cops. Space them out — wanted heat resets between jobs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run fixed routes — block one with your car, blow the rear doors, grab the cash and lose the tail.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit — check the region list in the pause menu for the ones you are missing and drive the coast road to sweep the rest.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang turf is marked on the map — hit the smallest op per gang first; each gang's op counts once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit at the beach bar, order the cocktail and watch the sunset — the trophy pops after the short cutscene.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the showroom glass — any showroom works; the big Vice City one is the easiest.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a full frame at the alley — a strike is not required, just finish the game. (Single source: GTAScoop — the method is not yet confirmed by a second guide.)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Most likely tied to a partner-activity milestone — community reports point to maxing a partner's approval during a shared activity. (Single source: GTAScoop — treat as provisional until a second guide confirms it.)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a counter toward 500 — make dialogue and story choices as you play; it accumulates across the whole run, no farming needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned the trigger yet. The name hints at succeeding on a second try; the community is still testing theories. Check the sources linked below for updates before hunting it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned the trigger yet. The name hints at witnessing something strange — likely a rare world event or easter egg. Marked honestly until two sources agree on the method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a pedestrian and swing a melee weapon from the car window — one hit counts; pick a quiet street to avoid the cops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — hand them to a laundering contact and the counter climbs; $250k total, not in one go.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It comes naturally — clothes, weapons, car mods and food all count. If you are short late-game, buy the most expensive car mod repeatedly.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale across Leonida as you progress — buy each one when its marker appears; you need the cash, so save up.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive any 10 vehicles and register each one in the app — stolen cars count, so grab whatever is parked nearby.
